title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Morgan McKinley is looking for an experienced, Accounts Assistant to work for a well established company in Horsham, West Sussex area. This a great job opportunity for someone with proven transactional finance experience to support the FC, dealing with everyday purchase ledger, sales ledger and month end duties, that is also keen to study and progress their accounting career!

Location: Office based - Horsham, West Sussex

Hours: Monday to Friday 9-5

Accounts Assistant duties:
- Process purchase invoices and prepare the payment run
- Raise and control the issue of purchase orders
- Bank account and balance sheet reconciliations
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date supplier records
- Assist with analysing the management accounts and month end
- Support with audits

Skills and experience:
- Experience working in a similar Accounts Assistant / Finance Assistant type role and keen to progress
- Ideally be AAT qualified or an keen to study ACCA / CIMA
- Excellent communication and IT skills

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Horsham £25,000-£27,000
Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm On-site parking

Do you have some initial Accounts/Finance experience and feel ready to broaden your knowledge, take on more responsibility and continue developing your career?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established business in Horsham, working closely with the Financial Controller in a busy and varied role offering exposure across a broad range of accounting responsibilities.

You'll get involved in much more than day-to-day transactional finance, making this a great next step for someone keen to learn, develop and build their experience.

What you'll be doing
- Assisting with monthly management information and management accounts
- Preparing accruals, prepayments and journals
- Bank and balance sheet reconciliations
- Investigating and reporting on variances
- Supporting the year-end audit
- Purchase and sales ledger
- Processing supplier payments and customer invoices
- Credit control and employee expenses
- Supporting the Financial Controller with wider projects

About you

You'll have some practical experience within an Accounts environment and be keen to continue developing professionally. You may already be studying towards AAT, CIMA, ACCA or ACA, or looking for a role that will support your longer-term accounting career.

You'll be organised, accurate and confident with Excel, with a positive approach and willingness to learn.

What's on offer
- £25,000-£27,000
- Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm with an hour for lunch
- On-site parking
- Study support available following successful completion of probation
- Broad exposure and plenty of opportunity to learn and develop

If you're looking for your next Accounts role and want an opportunity where you can broaden your experience and continue progressing, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today for immediate consideration.

title: Order Processing Specialist
company: Randstad Construction and Property - Agency - Contract
description:
Are you a highly organised professional with a sharp eye for detail who thrives in a fast-paced environment? We are actively partnering with a large global manufacturer to recruit a dedicated Order Processing Specialist to join their on-site team in Horsham. This is a fantastic opportunity to secure a 12-month contract with an industry leader, offering an immediate start for the right candidate.

This role is critical to the smooth operation of the business. You will work under the direction of the Order Processing Team Leader to submit client orders and ensure all requirements and specifications are perfectly met.

The Details
- Pay Rate: 14.68 per hour
- Hours: 38.75 hours per week, working days from Monday to Friday, 8:30 - 17:00
- Location & Workplace: 100% Onsite in Horsham
- Duration: 12 months (ASAP start)

What You Will Do
- Proficiently utilise the large global manufacturer's systems to create and approve orders within their Global Project Management System
- Ensure that all submitted orders and associated paperwork are completely accurate
- Maintain strict compliance with all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Health and Safety Policies through ongoing training and refresher programs
- Meet essential Key Performance Indicators and ensure both internal and external client expectations are satisfied.
- Highlight opportunities to improve process efficiencies to help achieve broader business objectives
- Communicate effectively with other departments and maintain high housekeeping standards
- Undertake ad-hoc duties as required by your Line Manager

What We Are Looking For
- GCSEs or equivalent qualifications/experience, specifically including Mathematics and English
- Strong computer literacy, particularly with Excel and Data Entry
- Excellent interpersonal communication skills, both written and verbal
- A high level of accuracy and strong attention to detail
- The ability to plan, prioritise, and coordinate tasks successfully
- A demonstrated ability to effectively guide, coach, and mentor others
- Previous background working within an operational environment or a Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) environment

. If you are looking to advance your career and support a major global operation, we would love to see your CV.

Randstad CPE values diversity and promotes equality. No terminology in this advert is intended to discriminate against any of the protected characteristics that fall under the Equality Act 2010. We encourage and welcome applications from all sections of society and are more than happy to discuss reasonable adjustments and/or additional arrangements as required to support your application.

Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK.

For the purposes of the Conduct Regulations 2003, when advertising permanent vacancies we are acting as an Employment Agency, and when advertising temporary/contract vacancies we are acting as an Employment Business.
